Updating transit networks

To update transit networks in the MHN and MRN:

  1. Review configuration settings in \Scripts\transit_update.toml and update them if necessary.

  2. Execute uv run tbmtools update to run tbmtools.transit.

  3. Review the verification results in \output\transit_line_verification_report.csv.

  4. Investigate the results further using the Verify Transit Network Toolbox in \VerifyTransitNetwork\VerifyTransitNetwork.aprx. Notes can be added to \route_verification_notes.yml. These notes will show up in the report the next time it’s executed.

  5. Repeat steps 1 through 4 until the verification results are acceptable.

Line and segment data tables for bus and rail are written to \output. Use MHN and MRN tools to load these tables into the geodatabases.

  • bus_lines_current.csv

  • bus_segments_current.csv

  • rail_lines_current.csv

  • rail_segments_current.csv
